column1: > SFG20 is a commercial (BESA) maintenance specification; its task
> schedules are licensed and must not be reproduced here. This file shows
> how real SFG20 (or in-house) task templates would link to assets by
> `asset_type`. A production deployment would load the actual SFG20
> schedule under licence into the same schema.

column5: Boiler annual service and flue inspection
Chiller quarterly refrigerant and oil check
Pump six-monthly seal and vibration check
Fan coil annual clean and filter change
VAV box annual damper and sensor check
Radiator annual valve and leak check
Lighting annual condition and emergency check
Access controller annual reader and lock audit
Fume cupboard six-monthly LEV face-velocity check
